captions: Tab. 9.38: Bilanzierungsdaten für die Umwandlung von 1 kg NOx in N2
Tab. 9.37: Auslegegrössen für eine SCR-Anlage bei Kohlefeuerungen (IIP 1990)
reason: Tab. 9.38 (p.141) gives the inventory data for the conversion of 1 kg of NOx into N2 — precisely the reference flow of the 'NOx retained, in SCR' dataset (the ammonia, catalyst and energy consumed per kg NOx removed). Tab. 9.37 on p.140 gives the design parameters of the SCR unit for coal firing that the balance rests on. The Fig. 11.x NOx captions later in the report are country-specific emission results, not the SCR inventory.
